text:
Taylor: quick heads-up — noticed README streaming example for Node and the curl snippet disagree on auth + streaming API shape. new devs copying the examples hit an infinite hang or 401s.

Taylor: curl snippet currently in docs/quickstart/streaming/README.md:
```bash
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'X-API-KEY: $REDWOOD_KEY' \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-lite","stream":true,"input":"hi"}'
```

Morgan: ah, another auth var mismatch + old header. our canonical is REDWOOD_API_KEY and header should be `Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY`. also the Node streaming example uses the SDK call `client.stream()` but the current snippet shows `client.streamChat()` (old name) and expects an EventSource-style callback that we don't support. that explains the hang.

Ivy: i dug into sample-apps/streaming/node and found the README there also uses `REDWOOD_KEY` and the old `streamChat` name. looks like a copy/paste drift from early prototyping.

Docs Bot: repo scan: found "REDWOOD_KEY" in docs/quickstart/streaming/README.md and sample-apps/streaming/node/README.md; found `streamChat` in docs/quickstart/streaming/README.md and docs/snippets/old-stream-api.md.

Taylor: plan: standardize on `Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY` everywhere; update curl snippet and Node example to match the SDK surface `client.stream()` with an async iterator example and a minimal fetch-based fallback that demonstrates the SSE framing we send. add a one-line note about supported streaming formats.

Morgan: i'll open a PR that: 
- replaces header + env var usages
- updates Node example to ESM async iterator pattern:
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood-inference/js';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
for await (const chunk of client.stream({ model: 'gpt-lite', input: 'hi' })) {
  process.stdout.write(chunk.text);
}
```
- adds curl SSE example showing `Authorization: Bearer` and a short note "use --no-buffer to avoid curl buffering on some platforms"
- run `scripts/validate-examples.sh` in docs CI to ensure snippets parse

Ivy: also please update sample-apps/streaming/node README and add a small integration test that runs the Node snippet against tests/mock-stream-server and asserts we receive three chunks. that'll catch API shape regressions.

Morgan: PR #625 opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/625 — includes fixes, updates sample-apps, and adds a docs-lint rule to grep for `REDWOOD_KEY` and `Authorization:\s*X-API-KEY` patterns.

Docs Bot: quick preview: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/625 — lint run: scripts/validate-examples.sh exit=0, banned-patterns.txt found 0 matches. integration smoke: tests/mock-stream-server responded with 3 chunks in 120ms.

Taylor: can we add a tiny README checklist to the docs CONTRIBUTING guide: "verify auth header, env var name, and streaming API shape"? reduces copy/paste drift.

Ivy: added CONTRIBUTING note in the PR and filed DOCS-112 to track cross-language streaming parity (JS/Python/CLI).

Morgan: merged at 2501111550. pinged #onboarding and @support so they can point new users to the fixed snippets. thanks team — small drift but caught before onboarding really ramped up. :thumbsup:
